title: bright black light
style: Root-emograss trap reframed as slow fourth-world psychopastoral chamber: fractured 5/4 and 7/8 pulses beneath dusty Lo-Fi synths, bowed banjo detuned into glass marimba, shoegaze-ASMR vocal fry kept close and breathy, dense shifting jazz harmonies, granular bass, abrupt math-break refrains non-repeating through evolving lines, quirky prepared percussion and muted ensemble textures opening into a virtuoso choral-string outro; intimate stereo saturation, restrained dynamics, wide but muddy, tenderly disorienting.
